x.around: The best way to get around in Libreville if you don't have a car are taxis. For a trip from point A to B the fare is negotiated with the driver depending on the distance. Fares will double after 21:00. From or to the airport 2000 FCFA, or 4000 FCFA after 21:00. (1000 FCFA = €1.5, 10 000 FCFA = €15). Taxis are less expensive when shared or for short distances (100 to 500 FCFA).

x.intro: Libreville is Gabon's largest city and capital. It is a port city of 703,904 (2013) that is home to one third of the country's population.

cities.d: one of the four largest cities in Gabon, it lies on the Mpassa River and at the end of the Trans-Gabon Railway and the N3 road.

x.intro: Franceville is a city in the Jungle Interior region of Gabon, with a population of 110,568 (2013).

cities.d: a small town in Gabon lying on the southern bay of the Ndogo Lagoon.

x.intro: Gamba is a small town located in the Coastal Plain region of Gabon, on the Ndogo Lagoon, near the Atlantic Ocean. The town is surrounded by small plains and forests. Its name, meaning fog, is believed to come from the Eshira people who found the place foggy at times. Besides its amazing landscape and diverse biodiversity, Gamba is one of the economic hubs of Gabon. The town is home of the oil company Shell Gabon.

cities.d: a Vili- and Lumbu-speaking town of about 5,208 people on the coast, at the end of the N6 road, lying on a peninsula separated from the mainland by the Banio Lagoon

x.around: Mayumba is small and you can walk most places in town and also to the beach.

intro: Gabon is a country in Central Africa with an array of landscapes and wildlife in its 13 national parks.

other.d: two of Central Africa's most magnificent waterfalls; gorillas, chimpanzees, & forest elephants gather around its rivers and waterholes.

x.intro: Ivindo National Park is in eastern Gabon. Most famous for the spectacular Kongou and Mingouli waterfalls of the Ivindo River, known as the “wonders of Ivindo”, the park includes the Ipassa Makokou Biosphere Reserve and Langoué Baï, one of the 5 most important forest clearings in Central Africa. In 2021 the park was listed as a natural world heritage site by UNESCO.

other.d: a 100-km stretch of virgin beaches and adjacent rainforest, both scenic and a place to view leopards, elephants, gorillas, & monkeys on the beach.

x.around: In Loango National Park, the operator has created a circuit that allows you to see and experience all the park’s highlights and ecosystems. The starting point for most visitors is Evengué Island, just outside the park. From there, you can travel to Loango Lodge and their eco-camps in the jungle, the savannah, and on the beach.
x.intro: Loango National Park is in the Coastal Plain region of Gabon.

other.d: mix of savanna & dense forest along the Ogooue River; float along the river in pirogue, view ancient rock engravings, or track gorillas or mandrill monkeys with a pygmy guide.

x.intro: Lopé National Park is in the Central Highlands region of Gabon. The Lopé-Okanda ecosystem and landscape was declared a UNESCO World Heritage site in 2007.
